title: Network Storage library compatibility matrix
description: Which library builds this server supports, and the evidence that each pairing was tested. Embedded in the server binary; read by /v3/server-info (compat) and by scripts/compat-tested-with.ps1.

minimum.description: Lowest supported library version. Anything below it is 'unsupported'. Moving it needs 90 days at 'deprecated' and a minor server bump (docs/releasing.md).

recommended.description: Library version that is current. Anything below it (and at or above minimum) is 'outdated'.

libraries.description: Known library builds. 'legacy' is the bucket for every build that sends no version header.

deprecated.description: Version ranges whose support ends on the sunset date.

blocked.description: Version ranges with a security or data-loss problem. Reserved for those; the only immediate path to a refusal.

tested.description: One row per test run: which library, on which engine build, was tested with which server, and where the proof is. Compat engine runs (ci-only) and native editor runs (pass) write these rows (docs/editor-test-plan.md).

range.description: Space-separated comparators (<, <=, >, >=, =, or a bare exact version), all of which must hold: '1.2.1', '<1.2.0', '>=1.1.0 <1.3.0'. Extra spaces are tolerated, as in VersionRange.TryParse.

engineRange.description: Engine build comparators, e.g. '>=26.10'. Extra spaces are tolerated, as in VersionRange.TryParse.

revision.description: s&box package revision (the <revision> of .version 1.0.<revision>); assigned by sbox.game at publish, so recorded after it.

revisions.description: Revision range for a bucket, e.g. '<=309133'. Extra spaces are tolerated, as in VersionRange.TryParse.

minServer.description: Oldest server version this library works with.

announced.description: Optional: when the deprecation was published. When present, the release gate requires sunset to be at least 90 days later (docs/compatibility.md).

engine.description: For 'known-broken': the engine builds it breaks on.

commit.description: Server commit the run used, for release-commit matching.

library.description: Observed LibraryVersion, or git:<sha> for an unversioned library checkout.

revision.description: s&box package revision of the library, when known.

engine.description: Full s&box engine build string from the editor, e.g. 26.10.02.

os.description: Operating system the editor or game ran on, e.g. 'Windows 11 23H2'.

result.description: 'ci-only' is a green Compat engine run with no native s&box editor run; the release notes call it out. 'pass' is a native editor run.

items.description: Issue or PR reference (owner/repo#N) or a URL.

allOf.description: A 'pass' is a native s&box editor run, and a run without its engine build, OS and backend kind is not evidence (docs/editor-test-plan.md). Use 'ci-only' for a green Compat engine run with no native editor run.
